$comment: What: THE single source of every test setting (plan §3.2): default, type, unit, which tests it applies to, a plain-language description and whether the value is still 'to be confirmed' (TBC) from UAT/Dev data or by the team. How: never edited per run; override any setting for one run with an environment variable of the same name (LOAD_RATE=80 scripts/run-test.sh …) or --set NAME=value, or per environment in config/environments/<env>.json 'settings'; print the resolved values with scripts/print-settings.sh <env> [<subject> <test-type>]. Needs: nothing; tools/core/settings.mjs reads it (this $comment is dropped, never a setting). Outputs: the typed values in run-context.json (k6) and result.json conditions.settings. Types: rate = whole events (or alarms) per second ≥ 1; duration = 500ms, 30s, 10m, 1h30m (resolved to seconds); list = comma-separated rates; '' = unset (null). Secrets (DB_PASSWORD, GRAFANA_API_TOKEN, GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD) are environment variables only and never listed here.

RUN_ID.description: Tags test data (LOADTEST-<runId>-…) and names the run. Empty = automatic yyyymmdd-hhmmss at the run start. A custom id must be 1-20 letters/digits (no hyphen, no underscore).

PLAN_DEFINITION_SET.description: Which plan-definition set is ACTIVE for the run: a folder in test-data/plan-definition-sets/ (emr-service, kenya-sha-emr-service). Recorded with every result.

DATASET.description: Which event dataset the k6 tests send: a folder in test-data/datasets/ (ebuzima-emr, tiberbu-emr). Empty = the first compatible dataset of PLAN_DEFINITION_SET (emr-service → ebuzima-emr, kenya-sha-emr-service → tiberbu-emr).

EVENT_ACTION_ID.description: Which event template each iteration sends. Empty = the dataset's defaultActionId (visit-encounter).

EVENT_SOURCE.description: CloudEvent 'source' of every test event. Empty = the dataset's source (loadtest-emr).

FACILITY_ID.description: CloudEvent 'facilityid' of every test event. Empty = the dataset's facilityId (LOADTEST-FACILITY-01).

NOTE.description: Free text saved with the result (e.g. why this run was made).

PEAK_RATE.description: Expected peak load: the design figure of the cce-data-pipeline docs (§7.1). Every '× peak' compares with it.

EXPECTED_HEADROOM.description: Expectation: the service should withstand this many times the peak (stress = 4 × peak).

SMOKE_RATE.description: Smoke test rate: proves the script, data and setup work.

SMOKE_EVENTS.description: Total smoke events instead of a duration: SMOKE_DURATION = ceil(events / rate). Counts measured-phase events only.

LOAD_DURATION.description: Load test duration (measured phase, warm-up excluded).

LOAD_EVENTS.description: Total load events instead of a duration: LOAD_DURATION = ceil(events / LOAD_RATE). Measured-phase events only (warm-up excluded).

STRESS_EVENTS.description: Total stress events instead of a duration: STRESS_DURATION = ceil(events / STRESS_RATE). Measured-phase events only.

WARM_UP_RATE.description: Warm-up rate before measuring, so JVM start-up slowness is not measured.

LEVELS.description: HTTP breakpoint staircase: the rates tried one after the other (strictly ascending).

LEVEL_DURATION.description: How long each staircase level is held.

MATCHER_FLOOD_RATE.description: Matcher breakpoint (flood): send far above what the matcher can process and measure how fast it drains.

MATCHER_FLOOD_EVENTS.description: Total flood events instead of a duration: MATCHER_FLOOD_DURATION = ceil(events / MATCHER_FLOOD_RATE).

STEP_SLA_STORM_ALARMS.description: Step SLA breakpoint (storm): this many alarms all ring at once.

STEP_SLA_FIRST_RING_DELAY.description: Time from seeding the alarms to the first alarm ringing.

STEP_SLA_SEED_MODE.description: set: alarms spread round-robin over every (plan definition of the set × its mandatory step with a deadline, i.e. tolerance-days) pair, so the set matters; single-action: v1 behaviour, first plan definition + STEP_SLA_ACTION_ID only.

STEP_SLA_ACTION_ID.description: Action used by STEP_SLA_SEED_MODE=single-action; must be a mandatory ('must') action with a deadline (tolerance-days) of the set's first plan definition (the default fits emr-service; for kenya-sha-emr-service use e.g. consent-verification).

STEP_SLA_SEED_MISSED_ALARMS.description: Also seed MISSED rows (ring + 3 days). Off by default: avoids alarm storms days later.

STEP_SLA_PEAK_ALARM_RATE.description: Peak alarms per second for the Step SLA expectation and '× peak'. auto = ceil(PEAK_RATE × due alarms per event of the plan-definition set) (emr-service: 1, kenya-sha-emr-service: 1).

MAX_VUS.description: Upper bound for maxVUs of any HTTP scenario (virtual users k6 may start to keep the rate).

KAFKA_PRE_ALLOCATED_VUS.description: Kafka tests: VUs started up front; each VU owns one Kafka producer (threads + buffers). v1 value.

KAFKA_MAX_VUS.description: Kafka tests: most VUs (= producers) k6 may start. v1 value.

HTTP_P95_LIMIT_MS.description: 95th percentile HTTP response time must stay below this.

HTTP_MAX_FAILED_RATE.description: Share of failed HTTP requests must stay below this (0.01 = 1 %).

MIN_CHECKS_RATE.description: Share of passed k6 checks (e.g. status is 202) must stay above this.

MAX_DROPPED_RATE.description: Dropped iterations (events k6 could not start on time) allowed: below 0.1 % of planned events (D9). The exact count is always reported.

BREAKPOINT_MAX_DROPPED.description: Abort the staircase after this many dropped iterations.

K6_LIMIT_P95_MS.description: Dropped iterations or rate shortfall while p95 is below this = the load generator's limit, not the service's ('at least X/s (k6 limit)').

RATE_SHORTFALL_TOLERANCE.description: A window or level sending fewer than (1 − this) × target events counts as 'k6 could not send on time'.

MATCHER_MAX_BACKLOG.description: Events waiting in Kafka for the matcher must never exceed this.

MATCHER_MAX_CATCH_UP.description: After sending stops the matcher must have caught up (backlog ≤ 10) within this.

MATCHER_MAX_KAFKA_WRITE_ERRORS.description: Kafka write errors allowed in k6.

MATCHER_MAX_DEAD_LETTERS.description: New dead-letter-topic records allowed during the run.

STEP_SLA_MAX_WAIT.description: Longest an alarm may wait after ringing before Step SLA handles it. auto = 2 × the environment's services.stepSla.pollIntervalSeconds.

STEP_SLA_STORM_MAX_CATCH_UP.description: Storm: every alarm must be handled within this after the storm rang.

WATCH_INTERVAL.description: Sampling interval of the watchers and the service-metrics sampler.

CATCH_UP_LIMIT.description: How long watchers keep waiting for the backlog to clear after sending/ringing ends.

BREAKPOINT_CATCH_UP_LIMIT.description: Catch-up wait limit for breakpoint (flood/storm) runs.

STALL_TIMEOUT.description: No progress for this long while more than 10 are waiting → the watcher aborts the run (stalled).

IDLE_FLAT_DURATION.description: Counters flat (and nothing waiting) this long = the service is idle; checked before a run and by cleanup's 'still processing' guard.

IDLE_TIMEOUT.description: Give up waiting for idle after this (refused, exit 2).

ALLOW_OTHER_ACTIVE_PLAN_DEFINITIONS.description: false: other ACTIVE plan definitions matching the dataset events fail preflight for the matcher; true: only a warning and data checks expect the extra fan-out.

EVENT_MODE.description: Reserved: 'journey' (each iteration sends the patient's next journey step) is later work; only 'single' is accepted now.

WORKLOAD_PROFILE.description: Reserved for later (spec 007): path of a workload-profile JSON turned into ramping stages. Setting it now is refused (not implemented yet).

REPORT_WINDOW.description: Window size for 'when it started breaking'; widened automatically so there are at most 200 windows.

BREAK_CONSECUTIVE_WINDOWS.description: Windows (or samples) in a row that must break before 'started breaking' is reported.

SKIP_PREFLIGHT.description: Skip the preflight check (recorded in the result; not recommended).

MONITORING_REQUIRED.description: Prometheus/Grafana unreachable → preflight fails instead of warning.

PROMETHEUS_REMOTE_WRITE.description: Send k6 metrics to Prometheus (remote write) when monitoring is enabled in the environment.

K6_TREND_STATS.description: Trend statistics k6 sends by remote write (K6_PROMETHEUS_RW_TREND_STATS).

MIN_FREE_DISK_GB.description: Free disk required for results and (local) Docker data. The environment's safety.minFreeDiskGb overrides the default unless set by env var or --set.

CLEANUP_LEGACY_V1.description: Also select v1 test data by JSONB subject (v1 events had random/UUIDv5 ids). auto = on when the run id is not yyyymmdd-hhmmss or with --all.

CLEANUP_PAUSE.description: Pause between delete batches (lets WAL readers and autovacuum keep up).

CLEANUP_MIN_SAFE_WAL_GB.description: Stop cleanup when a replication slot's safe_wal_size falls below this.

CLEANUP_TEMP_INDEX.description: Temporary step_instance(matched_event_id) index during cleanup; auto = only if the environment's safety.allowTempIndex.

PROTOCOL_REFRESH_WAIT.description: Wait after loading/retiring plan definitions: the matcher's refresh interval + 5 s.

PLAN_DEFINITION_VERSION_SUFFIX.description: Appended to each plan-definition version (e.g. -loadtest) to avoid clashing with real protocols on shared environments.

BASELINE.description: Compare the run with this saved baseline (baselines/<name>.json) after it finishes.

BASELINE_TOLERANCE.description: A metric counts as better/worse only beyond this percentage (and the unit floor: 5 ms, 2 s, 100 events, 5 events/s, 20 alarms/s).

BASELINE_MIN_RUNS.description: Runs required per test to save a baseline (fewer only with --allow-fewer, marked provisional).
